fixed.summary: A cook trims ~/.cache/origingame/cook-v1 at most once an hour instead of after every cook. The trim reads every cached action, so each cook paid for the size of the whole store: about 5 s at 116k actions, even for a project of one scene. The store can now pass its cap (OG_COOK_CACHE_MAX_BYTES) by an hour's cooks; `og cache gc` still trims it on demand.
